subject: Dedicated locality attestation & provenance checklist — FinTrust review
messages:
From: Amelia Barnes <amelia.barnes@fintrust.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: FinTrust Security Team <security@fintrust.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Dedicated locality attestation & provenance checklist — initial request

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security and legal teams have one follow-up: we need a documented attestation that data for our dedicated deployment can be pinned to the us-west region, with an auditable provenance trace for data residency and deletion events. Specifically they asked for:

- An acceptance checklist of artifacts you can provide (configs, placement maps, snapshot hashes, logs).
- A short forensics playbook describing how a deletion/wipe is executed and how we can verify it.
- A timeline for delivering sample artifacts we can validate before we sign the addendum.

Can you confirm what you can produce and an estimated delivery date? We need this to complete our procurement signoff (targeting 12/10).

Appreciate it —
Amelia Barnes
Head of InfoSec, FinTrust
amelia.barnes@fintrust.com
[Attachment: fintrust_requirements.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Amelia Barnes <amelia.barnes@fintrust.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated locality attestation & provenance checklist — initial request

Hi Amelia —

Thanks for the clear ask. I9ve attached a draft checklist (redwood_locality_provenance_checklist_v0.3.xlsx) that enumerates the artifacts we can provide for a Dedicated deployment. Quick answers up front:

- Region pinning: supported for Dedicated; control plane will pin customer9s tenant to the requested AZ/region (us-west-2).
- Provenance artifacts: placement maps, host tags, periodic snapshot hashes, and host breadcrumb logs are available; we can provide a sample set for validation.
- Deletion verification: we provide a documented wipe playbook and signed snapshot-hash timeline showing the pre- and post-wipe state.

Rishi and Soojin, can you review the checklist and confirm the fields we can populate for FinTrust and whether we can produce a 1-2 day sample artifact bundle (placement map + breadcrumb log + snapshot hashes)?

Targeting: sample bundle delivered by 2026-11-24 EOD if feasible.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Technical Account Management
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_locality_provenance_checklist_v0.3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated locality attestation & provenance checklist — initial request

Karthik / team —

Confirmed: we can produce the sample artifact bundle. Notes and limitations below so Amelia9s team has the right expectations:

What we can provide immediately (sample bundle):
- placement_map_us-west-20261121.json (maps logical tenants to host pools; redacted host IPs, left host tag values).
- host_breadcrumb_log_sample.txt (time-ordered entries showing host-level operations: snapshot create, snapshot-hash calc, wipe command).
- snapshot_hashes_20261121.csv (sha256 hashes for nightly snapshots for tenant FT-2026-987 for the last 7 days).

What we cannot provide / constraints:
- We do not publish persistent raw host IPs; we will provide host tags and hashed identifiers for proof of placement.
- On Dedicated we can provide immutable snapshot hashes and a signed timeline but we do not perform third-party forensics role; customer or their auditor can validate hashes against provided artifacts.
- For ephemeral KV caches we can provide cache-eviction timestamps and eviction logs but not the in-memory contents.

For the deletion/forensics playbook we will include:
1) pre-wipe snapshot and hash collection procedure, with timestamps.
2) evacuation and workload drain steps.
3) wipe command sequence and scrub verification (including how to compute/verify resulting snapshot-hash).
4) post-wipe artifact generation and signing (signed manifest).

I will attach host_breadcrumb_log_sample.txt and snapshot_hashes_20261121.csv in the bundle. Can we target delivery to FinTrust on 2026-11-24 as Karthik suggested?

Soojin Lee
Senior Reliability Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: host_breadcrumb_log_sample.txt (text/plain)]

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Amelia Barnes <amelia.barnes@fintrust.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated locality attestation & provenance checklist — initial request

Amelia / team —

Thanks for the patience. A few acceptance-criteria items we recommend FinTrust include in their review to make the validation deterministic:

- Primary acceptance: verify placement_map shows all tenant allocations tagged with region=us-west and an immutable snapshot-hash for each daily snapshot over the requested window.
- Forensics validation: compare provided snapshot_hashes_20261121.csv to our signed manifest. The signed manifest will be PGP-signed by Redwood9s infra siging key (we will provide key thumbprint).
- Wipe confirmation: acceptance requires a post-wipe signed snapshot manifest demonstrating absence of new snapshots for that tenant and a host_breadcrumb_log entry showing the wipe command and verification step.

Operational notes:
- Delivery timeline: sample bundle: 2026-11-24 (as Soojin suggested). Full artifact set for audit: 2026-12-03.
- Runbook link (internal, sharing link below) includes exact manifest format and signing procedure.

We will also include a short one-page "forensics playbook" that outlines step-by-step verification a customer auditor can run.

Rishi Malhotra
Principal SRE, Dedicated Ops
Redwood Inference
[Related link: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/security/FT-provenance-runbook]

From: Amelia Barnes <amelia.barnes@fintrust.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: FinTrust Security Team <security@fintrust.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated locality attestation & provenance checklist — initial request

Karthik / Rishi / Soojin —

This looks good and addresses our main concerns. Two quick asks before we proceed to formal sign-off:

1) Can Redwood include the infra signing key thumbprint and a short verification snippet (commands) in the bundle so our auditors can validate signatures offline?
2) Can you confirm the SLA fallback behavior if a region outage forces a temporary failover (we understand pinning is configurable, but auditors want wording for the exception path)?

If you can include those items in the sample bundle tomorrow (11/24) we9ll run a quick internal validation and aim to complete procurement by 12/08.

Best,
Amelia Barnes
Head of InfoSec, FinTrust
[Attachment: fintrust_signoff_template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
